map.录入防护用品上次更换日期与建议周期，自动提示下次更换时间。: Enter the last replacement date and the recommended cycle of protective equipment to automatically show when the next replacement is due.
map.对临期/逾期用品标红提醒，避免超期使用失效。: Highlight items that are near due or overdue in red, to avoid continued use past expiry when protection has degraded.
map.按用品类别（滤棉、耳塞、手套等）分批跟踪。: Track in batches by equipment category (filter media, earplugs, gloves, etc.).
map.下次更换 = 上次更换日期 + 建议周期(天)；剩余天数 = 下次 − 今天；剩: Next replacement = last replacement date + recommended cycle (days); days remaining = next replacement − today; remaining ≤0 is overdue and ≤7 days triggers a near-due reminder. Set the cycle according to the item instructions or corporate rules, such as dust filter media 30 days, earplugs 90–180 days, hard hat shell 30 months.
map.防尘口罩滤棉上次更换 2026-08-20、周期 30 天，下次 2026-09: A dust mask filter last changed 2026-08-20 with a 30-day cycle is next due 2026-09-19; safety shoes with a 365-day cycle last changed 2026-01-10 are next due 2027-01-10; hearing protection with a 135-day cycle last changed 2026-06-01 is next due 2026-10-14, with reminders starting 7 days ahead.
map.以产品说明与行业/企业安全制度为准；受污染、破损或过期不论是否到期都应提前更换。: Defer to product instructions and industry or corporate safety rules; anything contaminated, damaged or expired should be replaced early regardless of the due date.
map.临期提醒后还能用几天？: How many days can it still be used after the near-due reminder?
map.临期仅作预警，逾期即应停用更换；涉及呼吸防护等关键的，建议到期前完成换新不留空档: Near-due is only an early warning; once overdue it should be taken out of service and replaced. For critical items such as respiratory protection, finish the replacement before expiry so there is no gap.
